Cancellation Rules for e-tickets

  1. Cancellation of tickets can be made upto two hours before the scheduled departure time at the origin of service.
  2. For cancellation of tickets, cancellation fee is calculated on the basic fare as per slabs mentioned below.
  3. Proportionate basic fare after deduction of cancellation fees as per slab below will be refunded. Other incidental charges will not be refunded.
  4. Normally, the refund amount will be credited to debited account within 8 working days.
  5. In the event of cancellation of bus service by WBTC due to any reason, full basic fare will be refunded to the debited account.
